message.content: The average adult human brain weighs roughly **1.4 kg** (about 3 pounds). Male brains tend to be slightly heavier on average than female brains, but this difference is largely proportional to overall body size rather than sex alone. Brain weight also varies with age, health status, and individual genetics.
